newsitem.title: USA: Arrow Q1 shr $50. vs $1.20 after gain.
newsitem.headline: Arrow Q1 shr $50. vs $1.20 after gain.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: 1996 Q1 includes balances and earnings from company's former banking operations in Vermont. Gains derived from the sale in the first quarter of 1996 of about one-half of the company's Vermont branch offices affected year-to-year comparisons.

Adjusting for nonrecurring items, most notably gain from sale of the Vermont branches, core earnings for Q1 1997 were $2.3 million,or $0.40 a share, compared with $2.5 million, or $0.40 a share in Q1 1996.
Full company name is Arrow Financial Corp.
